style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: Minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly on a brushed steel surface. An asymmetric off-centre composition featuring three distinct interlocking hardware modules, each with a conflicting physical timing indicator, failing to perfectly align with a central routing bay. Hard clean edges, matte muted industrial palette with one amber accent, single directional light throwing a long cast shadow. Generous negative editorial space.
negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, watermarks, typography, labels, garbled text
rationale: The component assembly treatment perfectly captures the structural nature of platform integration and data seams. A physical representation of interlocking but misaligned modules conveys the technical barrier of conflicting timestamps.
